Author: Krishan Pahal

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Danish,Rajiv Sisodia
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Shashank Dwivedi, Advocate holding brief of Sri Rajiv Sisodia, learned counsel for applicant, Sri Sunil Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
3.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No.397 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504, 506, 323 IPC and 67A I.T. Act, Police Station Shikarpur, District Bulandshahr with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

4. As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to have established corporeal relationship with the victim for about six months on the false promise of marriage and had clicked certain indecent Mustkeem vs State Of U.P. on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63799517/
1 photographs and video of the victim and made them viral on Instagram portal.
5.
Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The victim was a consenting party.
She is a married lady, as such, it is implied that she was major.
She has been married off subsequent to the instant incident.

The Instagram I.D. from which the said photographs and video are stated to have been posted is aadityathakur0007 and the name of applicant is Mustaqueem, as such, he has nothing to do with the said offence.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has further stated that no mobile has been recovered from the applicant, rather the truth is that the applicant had gone to work at Saudi Arabia and his mobile was lost in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia and he lodged a report for the said lost mobile there.
Somebody else has used the said mobile.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has also argued that the said report has been filed alongwith its'
transcription in hindi as annexure No.11 to the affidavit filed with the bail application.
The applicant is in jail since 19.03.2025 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.

In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
8.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application on the ground that the In-charge, Cyber Crime Bulandshahr had given a report to the S.H.O., Bulandshahr, which indicates that the said Instagram I.D. aadityathakur0007 was used through registered mobile no.8938889661.

It is the same mobile number which is stated to have been lost by the applicant at Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, as such, it is an open and shut case as the said Instagram I.D. was generated by using the said mobile of the applicant.

9. Learned A.G.A. has further stated that the applicant has misused his clout and trust of the victim.
The victim has provided screen shots of the said video to the Investigating Officer by transferring it in a pen-drive.

10. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the applicant had made viral the indecent video of the victim by using his mobile and generating a fake Instagram I.D. i.e. aadityathakur0007, I do not find it a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.
11. The bail application is found devoid of merits and is, accordingly, rejected.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 9.5.2025 (Ravi Kant) (Justice Krishan Pahal)
